does: Answers whether any member of the joining creature's combat group, as the combat group mapping lists it, has relation 100 to the creature and is surprised.

evidence.says: the Toolkit's EoCServer.dll exports the name, with the same walk in the export's body
called from code:esv::combat::SurprisedSystem::SurpriseEntitiesJoiningCombat alone; it ends with code:unplaced::IsSurprisedOrAskedToBe on each member

questions.ask: Reached in a scene where two hostile humans share a combat group set through Osiris; a probe that counts its calls there would confirm it.
